_help: Social posting controls. mode: off = do nothing, dry_run = build the queue and preview captions on haultimes.com/editor/social/ but never post, live = post for real. There is no daily limit: every story that passes the checks is queued and posted one at a time. min_gap_minutes = minimum spacing between posts (test setting). hours = posting hours, Eastern (start, end); verified breaking news may post outside them. min_score = importance needed for this platform. max_age_hours = skip a story if it waited longer than this since publication. topic_gap_hours = don't post a second story on the same topic within this many hours unless it scores 15+ above min_score. Story ids are on haultimes.com/editor/.

facebook.a1b2c3d4e5: Your own caption text. The HaulTimes link is added automatically.
